svg.title: GitHub public contributions
svg.desc: Isometric public commit calendar from 15 Nov 2025 to 14 Nov 2026. 365 dated cells include zero-count days; 1069 contributions across 74 active days. Cell height is linear within this snapshot, at 0.576923076923 SVG units per contribution, with a maximum bar height of 75 units. Source scope: GitHub GraphQL contribution-calendar days visible to the public; the request uses no read:user scope and does not request restricted-contribution fields. Aggregate counts do not measure work quality or intensity.
svg.text: Data through 14 Nov 2026 · 1069 contributions across 74 active days; 365 dated days.

Source scope: GitHub GraphQL contribution-calendar days visible to the public; the request uses no read:user scope and does not request restricted-contribution fields. All 365 dated cells are shown, including zeros; totals do not measure work quality or intensity.
Linear within this snapshot: 0.576923076923 SVG units per contribution; maximum bar 75 units. Exact counts appear in each cell description.
